question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Payments can be made by __________ or in cash.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cheque**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cheque **is a written order to a bank to pay a certain amount of money to the person whose name is on the cheque. (किसी बैंक को उस व्यक्ति को एक निश्चित राशि का भुगतान करने का लिखित आदेश जिसका नाम चेक पर है)
 
• It is a commonly used method of payment, especially for larger amounts.
 
• The correct usage in the sentence is &a
